new_today_news.headline: India Gives Green Light to Commercial Sustainable Jet Fuel Production
new_today_news.summary: Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) has produced its first batch of sustainable aviation fuel at the country's first commercial-scale SAF plant and received government clearance for commercial supply. The Panipat Refinery will have capacity to meet India's 1% blending target for international flights in 2027.

new_today_news.headline: India fuels SAF hub ambitions, turning used cooking oil, ethanol and farm residue into jet fuel
new_today_news.summary: India is preparing to unveil a draft sustainable aviation fuel policy aimed at producing 10 million tonnes annually by 2040. The country aims to become a key exporter of SAF made from used cooking oil, ethanol, and agricultural residue.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Earnings Call Signals Stronger Growth Ahead
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reaffirmed FY2026 combined adjusted EBITDA guidance of $2.2–$2.3B, with core business contributing ~$1.25B and DGD capturing $1.50–$2.00/gallon on 1.2B gallons. Q3 nine-month revenue reached $5.1B; management expects near-double-digit collagen growth and potential Tessenderlo closing in early 2027.

backfill_news.headline: How a Grease Trap Works, and Where the Oil and Wash Water From a Kitchen ESP Go
backfill_news.summary: Educational guide on grease trap operation and waste management procedures. Covers how grease traps function, pumping frequency, and regulatory compliance including FOG disposal manifests required by most municipalities in 2026.

backfill_news.headline: Top 10 Best Solid Waste Routing Software of 2026
backfill_news.summary: Comprehensive guide covering solid waste routing software solutions including ORTEC, WorkWave, WasteHero, and others with sensor-based route optimization for municipal collections.
